title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
authors: Jianru Ding; Ryien Hosseini; Pouya Mahdi Gholami; Mingyuan Xiang; Henry Hoffmann
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, PD disaggregation, Long-context / Prefix cache, Energy / Carbon, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: Agentic tasks span many dependent turns whose total cost is unknown at arrival. Existing multi-turn systems keep the turn as the scheduling unit, so deciding whether to disaggregate each turn requires predicting unobservable decode-side quantities (decode length, tool behavior, KV growth), making per-turn placement structurally brittle and misaligned with the conversation-level latency users actually experience.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic 任務由多輪相依的推理與 tool call 組成，抵達時總成本未知。既有多輪系統以 turn 為排程單位，決定是否對每個 turn 解耦合時必須預測不可觀測的 decode 端數值（decode 長度、tool 行為、KV 成長），使逐 turn 放置在結構上脆弱，且與使用者實際感受的 conversation 層級延遲脫節。

key_innovation.en: Raises the scheduling unit from the turn to the conversation, collapsing turn-level irregularity into a stable two-phase structure: a compute-bound turn-1 prefill followed by a memory-bound tail. ConServe routes the first-turn prefill to a high-throughput prefiller, transfers the KV cache exactly once, and pins the conversation to a single decoder for its lifetime, driven only by observable signals (first-turn input length, per-decoder KV occupancy) with no learned decode-cost model; the phase split maps directly onto heterogeneous GPU tiers.
key_innovation.zh: 將排程單位由 turn 提升至 conversation，使逐 turn 的不規則性收斂為穩定的兩階段結構：compute-bound 的首輪 prefill 加上 memory-bound 的長尾。ConServe 將首輪 prefill 路由至高吞吐 prefiller、僅傳輸一次 KV cache，並將 conversation 固定於單一 decoder 直到結束；排程僅依賴可觀測訊號（首輪輸入長度、各 decoder 的 KV 佔用率），完全不需 decode 端成本的學習模型；此階段切分亦可直接映射至異質 GPU 層級。

key_improvements.en: Reduces p95 TTFET by 51.08% and improves energy efficiency by 7.51% vs the per-turn prediction baseline (AMPD) while preserving last-turn TBT and sustaining zero SLO violations at saturation; mapping the two phases onto heterogeneous GPU tiers adds a further 22.75% in tokens-per-joule.
key_improvements.zh: 相較逐 turn 預測式基線（AMPD），p95 TTFET 降低 51.08%、能源效率提升 7.51%，同時維持最後一輪 TBT，並在飽和點維持零 SLO 違規；將兩階段映射至異質 GPU 層級可再提升 22.75% 的 tokens-per-joule。

reported_accuracy: R² 1.000 (quadratic prefill-latency fit vs input tokens); R² 0.981 (linear KV-transfer latency fit)
validation_workloads: Agentic traces from SWE-bench_bm25_13K with swe-agent (Poisson arrivals 0.5-1.634 conv/s)

scope_assumptions.en: Single 4-GPU node with one prefiller and pinned decoder replicas; decoders are deliberately overprovisioned so the prefiller saturates first, and no decode-side cost is predicted by design. Heterogeneous GPUs are emulated by power-capping A40s to 2/3 TDP, and the AMPD baseline's bidirectional KV transfer is simulated rather than implemented.
scope_assumptions.zh: 單一 4-GPU 節點，一個 prefiller 搭配固定綁定的 decoder 副本；刻意超額配置 decoder 使 prefiller 先飽和，且設計上不預測 decode 端成本。異質 GPU 以將 A40 power cap 至 2/3 TDP 模擬，AMPD 基線的雙向 KV 傳輸以模擬延遲取代實作。
